detail.longDescription:
I've just released v0.0.8 of zopt (https://codeberg.org/hgrsd/zopt). 

This release improves the API for parsing positional arguments based on the heuristic that anything that isn't claimed by a previously requested option or flag (or anything after the -- terminator) is a positional argument. (thx to @liberty@mathstodon.xyz for the push to build a better positional API!)

It also replaces intOption and floatOption with a more generic optionAs(T, ...) which can parse floats, ints, and enum variants.
